label: Diagram 11
caption: Diagram 11 Key dimensions associated with passenger lifts
description:
This diagram, titled "Diagram 11 Key dimensions associated with passenger lifts," depicts a three-dimensional perspective view of a lift landing and the lift car controls.

On the left, the landing area shows a wall with "Landing call buttons with tactile identification" and a "Sign showing storey with tactile identification." An arrow indicates a "900mm" vertical distance between the buttons and the sign. A dimension line shows the "Range for centre lines of landing call buttons" is "1100mm" from the side wall. Below this, an "Unobstructed wheelchair turning space" is indicated by a square area measuring "1500mm" by "1500mm," with a minimum "800mm min." width for access.

On the right, the lift car interior is shown. It features "Lift car controls with tactile identification" and a "Handrail." The "Range for centre lines of lift car controls" is "1200mm" from the back wall, positioned "900mm nominal" above the floor. The handrail is "1100mm min." high. Floor dimensions include a "400mm" depth and a "1400mm min." width.
